title: Bind a Name to a Spell
prompt: Build the line that files an incantation under its name in the grimoire.

fragments.wrong_hint: Round brackets call a function. To pick a KEY, use square brackets: ["fire"].
== asks whether two things are equal. To STORE a value under a key, use a single =.

config.success: grimoire["fire"] = "Ignis" — the name now points to its incantation.
